provider_health.boundary: A configured key is not proof of live quota or provider uptime; the scheduled workflow records real provider failures separately.

recovery.cadence: hourly while the buffer is below target
next_steps: Seed a distinct fast-lane mechanism topic before spending another deep-research attempt.
Stage up to five approved storyboards per recovery shift.
Send staged Shorts to the bounded fourteen-episode Studio buffer.
Publish only after image, assembly, and Quality Gates pass.

research_sla.rule: A recovery question has a finite attempt budget. When it is exhausted, its record remains available for learning but it no longer occupies a live slot; the next recovery run can seed a distinct topic.
research_sla.next_action: seed a distinct fast-lane question; do not retry an exhausted question as if it were new

evidence_reserve.next_action: research and qualify distinct new topics; historical briefs already handed to Story do not count as new production inventory

content_expansion.rule: Follow-up angles are preserved, but each one independently earns evidence before production.

source_coverage.boundary: Coverage counts accepted observations only; they do not prove a source is correct or rank it above the evidence gate.

evidence_reserve.boundary: A question is not evidence, and evidence is not a publishable video. Qualified evidence requires independent traceable sources; story briefs still pass novelty, production, and final Quality Gates.

alerts.detail: the OpenAI credit balance is exhausted (HTTP 429 credit_balance_exhausted) -- image generation and the narration-timing speech check stop on every run until credit is added (2026-10-03: this silently halted all new episodes for 2 days).
the last 3 episodes with motion attempts used the still-hold fallback for every scene -- the real motion provider may be unreachable, not just occasionally rejecting a scene.
only 0 of 105 recovery topics remain unused -- the reserve will stop seeding new fast-lane questions once this reaches zero, the same way it already did once.
